- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The recommended oil change interval for a Honda Civic varies depending on the model year, engine type, and driving conditions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] For 2001-2011 Honda Civics, the recommended oil change interval is every 5,000 to 7,500 miles (8,000 to 12,000 km) with traditional oil.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] For 2012-2015 Honda Civics, the recommended oil change interval is every 7,500 to 10,000 miles (12,000 to 16,000 km) with traditional oil.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] For 2016 and newer Honda Civics, the recommended oil change interval is every 10,000 to 15,000 miles (16,000 to 24,000 km) with synthetic oil.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Some Honda models, like the Civic Hybrid, may have different recommended oil change intervals.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If driving in extreme temperatures, towing a trailer, or driving in stop-and-go traffic, oil may need to be changed more frequently (every 5,000 to 7,500 miles).
